decision: A prospectively registered independent10Mb European parent is scientifically suitable for development and model selection. A second independent10Mb parent is preferable to interpreting many correlated rows from one chromosome as independent replication. The existing200MbVAL reservation is not a scientific prerequisite for this development task.
scope: Source/metadata-only assessment; no simulations, inference, scoring, target joins, original recipe edits or competitor source changes.

recommended_first_plan.label: Independent European10Mb native6 development VAL
recommended_first_plan.optional_second_parent: Freeze a second independent10Mb parent identifier and seeds prospectively if the same aggregate budget admits it; run sequentially. Do not shrink or redraw after observing accuracy.
recommended_first_plan.scientific_use: Iterative architecture development and explicit model/checkpoint selection; report as reused development VAL once consulted.

scientific_preservation: All476 diploids/952 haplotypes,686 queries,266 pure references, exact population and sample-age roster, cohort identity and sample order.
Original demographic events, times in generations, population sizes, census350, discrete Hudson ancestry and JC69 mutation model.
Mutation rate1.25e-8 and recombination rate1e-8 per base per generation; no rate rescaling with chromosome length.
Same observation sanitation, VCF filtering/polarization, native Relate1.2.4 settings, initial haploidNe30000, five size iterations and final branch-length reestimation,28 years per generation.
Fresh ancestry/mutation/Relate seeds in a distinct namespace, with collision checks against original eight parents and size-iteration offsets; complete new simulations rather than TRAIN/TEST crops.
Same native6 endpoint and paired observed-row registry for each compared model; original model/competitor scientific code unchanged.

map_and_coordinate_contract.original_map: Uniform fresh full-domain map, not an empirical varying-rate map.
map_and_coordinate_contract.selected_region: Explicit synthetic prefix[0,L); chooseL prospectively. The unchanged uniform map is restricted to this domain, not stretched or renormalized.
map_and_coordinate_contract.units: rate_cM_per_Mb=r_per_bp_per_generation*1e8; accumulated_map_cM=L*r*100. These are genetic-distance units, independent of sample-time conversion.
map_and_coordinate_contract.observed_coordinates: Original simulated positions are0based in[0,L); VCF positions arep+1. Preserve the source Relate conversion minus1 and actual observed coverage[left,right), with local_position=original_position-left.
map_and_coordinate_contract.native_coverage: Cleaner usesleft=min(convertedVCFpositions)-1 andright=max(convertedVCFpositions), retains native nodes/IDs inside actual coverage and never extrapolates missing tails. Record original_parent_interval[0,L), normalization_length=L and local_to_original_offset=left.
map_and_coordinate_contract.nonuniform_future_map: If a nonuniform map is later chosen, clip/interpolate its boundary positions, translate coordinates once and subtract the left cumulativecM value; do not rescale local rates or cumulative total to200Mb.

required_research_adapters: Freeze a separate short-development recipe whose only intended scientific delta is length and distinct parent/seed identity; keep all other canonical parameters byte-equivalent. Existing generator can use require_paper_match=False but this broad mode must be constrained by the short-plan comparison.

Use a separately named length-aware research native-inference adapter. Existing european_execution._approved requires the entire canonical recipe, and european_native_relate.infer_parent explicitly requires200Mb and emits a full200Mb schema. Do not weaken those production guards.

Reuse the native input preparation and tree-cleaning algorithms with the exact short recipe validation and truthful short-development provenance. The helpers already calculate numeric map endpoints/coverage from declared length.
Use a separately named length-aware sampled registry adapter; existing validation_sampling imports the200Mb LENGTH constant. Preserve observed SNP-rank/query-order policy and class labels.

Keep length provenance and original/local coordinate joins consistent in observation/model wrappers so all declared methods consume the same short observation and registry; no competitor retraining or algorithm changes are needed for the assessment.
development_interpretation: A short independent chromosome is sufficient to detect coding/feature-use failures and guide comparative architecture selection on the declared development distribution.

It cannot establish full200Mb long-history behavior, paper-test performance or stable across-parent variance; shortening changes the distribution of chromosome-level context and may affect inferred population-size estimates.
Two independent parents provide actual replication but still weak uncertainty estimates. Thousands of linked sites/rows are not thousands of independent experimental units.

Validation may be consulted repeatedly for model selection; label that use openly. Seal each candidate prediction/provenance before its own label comparison, and keep original TEST untouched during development.

storage_assessment.aggregate_scope: All declared development parents together, generation truth/observed output, complete native inference intermediates/scratch, observed registry, prediction/score metadata, logs and simultaneous temporary copies. Not16GiB per stage or per parent.
storage_assessment.planning_basis: Old120GiB generation+inference cap scales to6GiB per10Mb or12GiB per20Mb only as a planning heuristic. Retained200Mb generation+inference is about14.2to14.6GB, suggesting much smaller retained short output; neither observation proves peak native scratch.
storage_assessment.safe_execution_condition: A finite admitted attempt can fail closed at its own cap without changing the data. Review the exact short writer/native supervisor so known Python writes reserve bytes before writing, every native descendant and temporary output is charged, and a hard aggregate bound or justified native-write overshoot allowance stays inside the reserved buffer. A1GiB pre-step headroom check or periodic size poll alone is not proof of aggregate write containment.

recommended_next_action: Prepare the separate10Mb development recipe, coordinate/map metadata checks and bounded common observation/inference adapters now. Keep original TRAIN/TEST fixed. Admit the first short attempt using a fresh aggregate ledger and reviewed native-output guard; do not wait for a120GiB200MbVAL reservation merely to begin useful accuracy development.
